messages:
maria.f: @here Quick update — we've published a small but important change to contractor expense and small vendor approval thresholds. Please read the short summary below and the linked policy (1-min skim). https://redwood.internal/policies/expense-thresholds :memo:

maria.f: TL;DR: 
- Contractor reimbursements for equipment now need finance pre-approval if > $1,000 (previously $500).
- Any new vendor with > $25k ARR or recurring subscriptions requires the vendor questionnaire + standard contract review.
- P-card allowed for subscriptions up to $2,000 with manager + finance ops signoff.
- For one-off consultants, use the new "fast vendor" path for < $10k (no contract team review).

alex_p: Quick Q — for contractor monitors purchased by hiring manager, is the $1,000 cap per receipt or per contractor per year?

maria.f: Per contractor per purchase. If HR bundles multiple items on one receipt (desk+monitor) and it exceeds $1k we still need pre-approval. If it's >$1k but <=$2k and clearly hardware, escalate to finance ops (jordan_b) for faster review.

samuel: Heads up — we have a contractor requesting two monitors + dock (~$1,150). Is the new flow just submit the "contractor equipment" form?

maria.f: Yep — use the contractor equipment form (link in policy). Mark as "hardware: contractor" and tag @finance and @people-ops. Jordan will triage. :thumbsup:

jordan_b: I can pick up that request. For the team: when you submit the form, include a short justification and the vendor quote. If vendor is new, include vendor name + quick note on whether it's a marketplace purchase (e.g., Amazon) or direct vendor — that determines onboarding steps.

samuel: Thanks — submitting now. Also — does the p-card rule apply to SaaS purchases initiated by engineers during trials?

maria.f: P-card allowed for trials <= $2k but please route longer-term purchases through procurement (so we track commitments). If you expect renewal or yearly spend > $5k, submit a vendor request so we can do the ARR check.

procure-bot: New vendor request received: id=V-2026-089, submitted by samuel, amount est. $1,150. Status: pending finance triage.

alex_p: Is there an expedited approval for infra contractors who need gear immediately for onboarding? Could block start dates otherwise.

maria.f: Yes — include "expedite" in the form and @jordan_b will fast-track same-day if justified by start date. We expect managers to cover interim via office inventory if possible.

jordan_b: Also note: small vendor path (<$10k) removes contract review but still needs PO tracking and basic payment onboarding (W-9/Bank info). Finance ops will request those docs.

samuel: Awesome, thanks all. Filing the form and attaching quote.

maria.f: Thanks everyone — ping me or jordan_b if anything blocks. We'll follow up with a one-pager and example flows in the finance docs later today. :sparkles:
